rationale: The agent unilaterally cancelled the order without authenticating the user, without confirming the change, and without first addressing the user’s requested alternatives (split payment, removing the most expensive item, or switching to cheaper options). No tool calls are shown to verify the order or execute the cancellation, yet the agent stated the order was cancelled and provided a refund timeframe, which appears unsupported. These violate the stated policy to authenticate, act only on the user’s orders, confirm before writes, and avoid fabricating outcomes.
